info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Guarantee Management API
info.description: The Bank Guarantee Management API facilitates the updating and modification of existing bank guarantee records. It allows financial institutions and their customers to seamlessly manage guarantee terms, amounts, and statuses. This resource is essential for entities involved in trade finance, ensuring they can maintain current and accurate documentation. Common users of this API include banks, legal teams, and businesses engaged in international trade requiring guarantees for transactions.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specified bank guarantee. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields to reflect the changes accurately.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the bank guarantee details for the specified resource. It allows for partial updates through the PATCH method, enabling clients to modify specific fields without needing to resend the entire resource.
